ac_sketch: A superseded-lease write is rejected while the current-lease write persists (T15-F1-8)
An expired-lease runner's write is quarantined aside, not lost or landed (T15-F2-7)
Stalled (aged-heartbeat, empty-artifact) runners and late-writers are both flagged for reaping (T15-F4-4)
consolidation_rationale: T15-F1-8, T15-F2-7, and T15-F4-4 all live on the orphan-liveness axis and share the same underlying lease/heartbeat substrate (run-lease.json, outcome_liveness), but each covers a distinct failure shape: F1-8 rejects a write from a superseded (fenced-out) lease, F2-7 quarantines a write from a merely expired lease rather than dropping or landing it, and F4-4 adds the shared heartbeat/reaper layer that flags a runner as stalled or late-writing in the first place. Consolidating them into one capability avoids three separate PRs against the same lease-write seam while keeping each failure mode as its own acceptance criterion.
dod_sketch: Merged PR adds epoch fencing to every evidence write against the existing run-lease.json (rejecting superseded-lease writes with ORPHAN_WRITE_BLOCKED while the current-lease write persists), a quarantine-aside path for expired-lease late writes (quarantine_late_write(), reusing outcome_liveness), and a shared register/heartbeat + reaper (delegation_runners.py / reap_orphans.py) flagging stalled runners (aged heartbeat, empty artifacts) and late-writers-after-close. Verified by tests for each of the three failure shapes plus a regression pass on existing agy lease-write and saga R31 stalled-terminal tests.

executor_profile.justification: Mechanical, well-scoped change against two already-verified concrete code seams (agy_delegate.py's lease writes, outcome.py's liveness processor) with no architectural ambiguity left open; sonnet at high effort is sufficient, no case for opus-tier judgment or an external engine.
